summary: Elevate your remote sensing projects with our metadata management course. Gain essential skills to manage and utilize data efficiently for better outcomes.
lede: Remote sensing metadata management describes imagery so teams can find, interpret, validate, and reuse it. Designed for Earth observation data managers, geospatial analysts, metadata specialists, and project leads, the course covers metadata profiles, acquisition and processing lineage, quality checks, and searchable catalogue design using ISO 19115-1, STAC, and validation workflows.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who manage, describe, publish, govern, or consume satellite and airborne Earth observation data across distributed project environments. It is especially relevant when you need consistent records across sensors, processing levels, repositories, and delivery teams.
prerequisites: You should have working experience with remote sensing or geospatial data workflows, including raster imagery, coordinate reference systems, spatial and temporal extent, and basic data catalogue concepts. Familiarity with XML, JSON, GIS software, or cloud repositories is useful but not mandatory. No programming is required for completion. Python and command-line automation appear at operational awareness level, while metadata profile design, validation, and catalogue planning receive hands-on treatment.
